entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It was just sitting out in the open too...[n]Joker, let's make a run for it!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Come on, let's get out of here before they[n]see us.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There's definitely something fishy over[n]there. There's vines growin' on the door too.
entries.uk: Он там точно щось нечисто.[n]Та й двері заросли лозою.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah. By the looks of it, no one's been in[n]there for a long time.
entries.uk: Так. Судячи з усього, туди[n]вже давно ніхто не заходив.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I wonder what's over there... Should we take[n]a closer look?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, Joker. Do you see that handle-like[n]thing at the top of that arch?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You might be able to get to the other side[n]if you use your grappling hook there.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hang on, we gotta go check out that thing[n]we saw back there first.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Joker, c'mon! Let's go check out that door[n]back there.
